title: Readable-but-undecodable fallback font silently returns the unmerged atlas; load reports ok and the app runs glyph-less
detail: A fallback file that reads but fails to rasterize (truncated TTF) returns the main glyphs unmerged; load_fonts reports ok, so app/harness/palcheck run without U+26A0 — the exact quiet degradation B1 bans. MemAlloc-nil (line 1421) is the same class.
recommended_fix: Return nil, 0 when fg == nil || ng == 0 (and when merged == nil), mirroring the ferr path, so every caller's exit guard fires.

title: font_merge_fallback's fail-loud return-nil paths leak the already-loaded main glyph set
detail: glyphs (RL_MALLOC'd at line 1374 plus per-glyph image data, freed only by UnloadFontData) is discarded unfreed on both nil returns. The negative-control test hits the ferr path every CI run inside the test binary.
recommended_fix: Call rl.UnloadFontData(glyphs, count) before each fail-loud return nil, 0.

title: Font pins leak raylib-owned glyph memory: per-glyph image data, glyph arrays, and recs
evidence:
defer rl.MemFree(glyphs) // test-side: the merged glyph block is raylib-owned (r3 note)
...
	_, _, ok := font_atlas_build_from_file(FONT_ASSET)
	testing.expect(t, ok, "the committed HUD family must load")
...
	mono, am, okm := font_atlas_build_from_file(FONT_MONO_ASSET)
...
	defer rl.UnloadImage(am)
detail: MemFree frees only the array block; each glyph's image.data (freed only via UnloadFontData, rtext.c:993-999) leaks, and font_atlas_build_from_file's f.glyphs/f.recs are never released in font_guard_reports_missing_asset or font_mono_tabular_digits.
recommended_fix: Use rl.UnloadFontData in font_probe_warning; unload each built Font (rl.UnloadFont or UnloadFontData + MemFree recs) in the data-stage pins.

title: overlay_pixels_check never frees the LoadImageColors pixel buffer
detail: The ~3.7MB RL_MALLOC color buffer is never released; every sibling site (motion_pixel.odin:36-37, palcheck.odin:212-213, goldens.odin:202-205) defers rl.UnloadImageColors.
recommended_fix: Add defer rl.UnloadImageColors(px) immediately after LoadImageColors.

title: Catalog-sourced dynamic strings bypass lint gate 6; codepoints outside the 96-glyph atlas render blank with no load-time check
detail: Catalog text (cat.crises[...].display_name / preventive_redesign, tier.id via main.odin:1858) flows raw-byte into a 96-codepoint atlas; tools/lint.sh:56 scans only app/render/*.odin + app/main.odin literals, so a non-ASCII data/*.json string renders blank uncaught.
recommended_fix: Fail-fast ASCII-validate drawn catalog string fields at load, or extend lint gate 6 to data/*.json display fields.
